confidence_notes: Meal and coffee anchors rely on aggregated cost-of-living indexes seen in search-result summaries (Numbeo-derived data via Expatica/Wise, CityCost, MyLifeElsewhere). These are crowdsourced and vary by date. Beer (about $8) and cocktail (about $16) draw on Expatistan, which flagged few data points, and on 2026 nightlife guides. No reliable Seattle average for a restaurant glass of wine was found, so wine is inferred from sparse menu examples and the beer/cocktail relationship (about 1.6x beer, 0.8x cocktail). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season window. No accommodation searches were run and no live listings were inspected, so they are the least certain. The RBA rate comes from a search-result summary of RBA pages (18 Nov 2026 observation), not from a page I opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seattle-specific aggregates were used for food and drink where available. A 2026 nightlife guide placed Seattle between Portland (about $13.50 cocktail) and San Francisco (about $19), which bracketed the drink prices. Accommodation was reasoned by analogy with other high-cost US West Coast cities in summer peak season.
